-- Compiled proof, equivalent to #print DY.Example.SignedDH.client_auth
theorem DY.Example.SignedDH.client_auth :
∀ (client server : DY.Participant) (xPk yPk k : DY.Bytes) (time : Nat) (tr : DY.ExecTrace),
  DY.Trace.Reachable DY.Example.SignedDH.reachability tr →
    DY.Trace.EventLoggedAt (DY.Example.SignedDH.SignedDHEvent.ClientFinishEvent client server xPk yPk k) time tr →
      have tr_before := DY.Trace.prefix tr time;
      DY.Trace.EventLogged (DY.Example.SignedDH.SignedDHEvent.ServerFinishEvent server xPk yPk k) tr_before ∨
        ∃ spk, DY.LongTermKeys.LongTermKeyCompromised "SignedDH PKI" server spk tr_before
:=
fun client server xPk yPk k time =>
  DY.Trace.apply_Reachable_implies_Invariant fun tr h_trinv h_ev =>
    have this :=
      DY.Trace.EventLoggedAt_imp_EventInv (DY.Example.SignedDH.SignedDHEvent.ClientFinishEvent client server xPk yPk k)
        time tr h_trinv h_ev;
    DY.Example.SignedDH.client_auth._proof_1_1✝ client server xPk yPk k time tr
      (Eq.mp
        (congr
          (congrArg Or
            (congrFun'
              (congrArg And
                (congrArg (DY.Trace.EventLogged (DY.Example.SignedDH.SignedDHEvent.ServerFinishEvent server xPk yPk k))
                  (DY.Trace.prefix_erase tr time)))
              (k.Invariant (DY.Trace.prefix tr time) ∧
                k.label (DY.Trace.prefix tr time) =
                  (DY.Example.SignedDH.clientLabel client xPk).join (DY.Example.SignedDH.serverLabel server yPk))))
          (congrArg Exists
            (funext fun spk =>
              congrArg
                { isCorrupt := DY.LongTermKeys.LongTermKeyCompromised "SignedDH PKI" server spk,
                    isCorruptLater := DY.LongTermKeys.label._proof_2 "SignedDH PKI" server spk }.isCorrupt
                (DY.Trace.prefix_erase tr time))))
        this)
